Plans.Filter: ((status <> 'deleted'::resource_status) AND (((resource -> 'valueQuantity'::text) ->> 'system'::text) = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org'::text) AND (((resource -> 'code'::text) @> '{"code": "8480-6", "system": "http://loinc.org"}'::jsonb) OR ((resource -> 'code'::text) @> '{"coding": [{"code": "8480-6", "system": "http://loinc.org"}]}'::jsonb)) AND ((((resource -> 'valueQuantity'::text) ->> 'value'::text))::numeric >= '100'::numeric) AND ((((resource -> 'valueQuantity'::text) ->> 'code'::text) = 'mm[Hg]'::text) OR (((resource -> 'valueQuantity'::text) ->> 'unit'::text) = 'mm[Hg]'::text)))

sql: SELECT r.resource::text, r.id, r.txid, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM "public"."observation" AS r WHERE ((r.resource->'code' @> '{"code":"8480-6","system":"http://loinc.org"}'::jsonb OR r.resource->'code' @> '{"coding":[{"code":"8480-6","system":"http://loinc.org"}]}'::jsonb) AND ((r.resource->'valueQuantity'->>'value')::numeric >= $1::numeric AND r.resource->'valueQuantity'->>'system' = $2 AND (r.resource->'valueQuantity'->>'code' = $3 OR r.resource->'valueQuantity'->>'unit' = $3))) AND r.status != 'deleted' LIMIT 12
